fields.label: Department
fields.note: UI select 'Department' defaults to All; it slices the already-loaded own-site job array, so there is no request parameter.

fields.label: Country/Region
fields.note: UI select 'Country/Region' (default All); office taxonomy from the native Job Listing, no request parameter.

notes: Arcesium's own careers page embeds a complete unfiltered React 'Job Listing' dataset (mapped.jobs/departments/offices) whose ten-row UI paging is client-side; the only controls are a free-text search box plus Country/Region and Department selects that default to All. Recorded default filters are {search:'', country_region:'All', department:'All'}, and the exact detail links point at job-boards.greenhouse.io/arcesiumllc. Because membership and filtering happen in the client over one payload, no server-side search/filter request exists to reproduce; all filtering is local. jobs are paginated 10 at a time in the UI only.
